import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"max_tokens\":5,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Tell me a long story\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)

asyncio.run(main())
